digest.component_or_area: MCP server config ownership / seam enforcement
propositions: Below-seam ambient config/credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through approved composition-root seam via new owned resolvers in config.py
Three new owned composition-root resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) must be added to config.py to intercept and legitimize ambient config/secret access at the boundary
MCP files' below-seam load_config() calls and os.environ.get reads for auth secrets must be replaced with calls to the new seam-owned resolvers while preserving per-request resolution semantics
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be removed and check_config_ownership.py must pass with zero findings for these paths
Subsystem behavioral test suites (MCP facades, auth, contracts) must remain green and unmodified after the cutover, confirming no behavioral delta
